course_id.description: CourseID identifies the course within which the adaptive plan is scoped.

failed_topics.description:
FailedTopics is a non-empty list of knowledge-graph node names
representing concepts the student has not yet mastered.

mastered_topics.description: MasteredTopics lists concepts already known by the learner.

student_id.description: StudentID is the platform-level identifier for the learner.

telemetry.description:
Telemetry carries optional client-side diagnostic metadata.
When nil, telemetry is omitted from the serialized payload.

vark_profile.description:
VARKProfile specifies the student's dominant learning modality.
Accepted values: "visual", "auditory", "read_write", "kinesthetic".

edges.description: Edges contains directed relationships between nodes in the subgraph.

nodes.description:
Nodes contains the filtered concept nodes, each annotated
with the student's cognitive state.

details.description:
Details provides a human-readable explanation of the error cause.
Omitted when empty.
details.example: failed_topics must contain at least one topic

error.description:
Error is a machine-readable error code (e.g., "validation_error",
"rate_limit_exceeded", "service_unavailable").

status.description: Status is always "ok" when the service is running.

items_after_validation.description:
ItemsValidated is the count of study items remaining after the
graph validation stage retains requested topics and their prerequisites.

items_dropped.description: ItemsDropped counts distinct items outside the requested prerequisite closure.

items_generated.description:
ItemsGenerated is the total number of study items returned across
all per-topic LLM calls before deduplication.

items_skipped_mastered.description: ItemsSkippedMastered counts distinct mastered prerequisites excluded from study.

llm_latency_ms.description:
LLMLatencyMs is the wall-clock time (milliseconds) spent waiting
for all parallel LLM calls to complete.

resources_unreachable.description: ResourcesUnreachable counts sanitized resources removed by HTTP link checks.

subgraph_tuples.description:
SubgraphTuples is the number of knowledge-graph triples extracted
by the BFS subgraph traversal for the given failed topics.

topics_processed.description:
TopicsProcessed is the count of failed topics that were individually
sent to the LLM via the parallel fan-out stage.

total_latency_ms.description:
TotalLatencyMs is the end-to-end pipeline duration (milliseconds)
from request receipt to response serialization.

explanation.description:
Explanation is a concise rationale generated by the LLM describing
why this topic is relevant to the student's failed assessment. It contains
at most 1000 runes, with Unicode control and format characters removed.
explanation.example: Polymorphism allows objects to be treated as instances of their parent class.

prerequisite_chain.description:
PrerequisiteChain lists the ordered prerequisite path leading to this
topic, extracted from the knowledge graph via topological sort.

priority.description:
Priority determines the recommended study order. 1 = highest priority
(study first). Included prerequisites precede their dependent topics.

resources.description:
Resources contains 0-3 learning resources whose type strictly matches
the student's VARK profile.

topic.description: Topic is the knowledge-graph node name this item targets.

_meta.description:
Meta exposes internal pipeline metrics for observability dashboards.
Serialized under the "_meta" key to distinguish it from domain data.

course_id.description: CourseID is echoed from the request for client-side correlation.

items.description: Items is the ordered sequence of study items, priority-sorted (1 = study first).

student_id.description: StudentID is echoed from the request for client-side correlation.

resource_type.description:
ResourceType is normalized to lowercase and restricted to these values per VARK:
  kinesthetic: "exercise", "lab", "coding-challenge"
  visual:      "video", "diagram", "infographic"
  auditory:    "podcast", "lecture", "audio-course"
  read_write:  "article", "textbook", "documentation"

title.description: Title is a name of at most 200 runes, with Unicode control and format characters removed.

url.description: URL is an absolute HTTP(S) link without userinfo, at most 2048 characters.

client_version.description: ClientVersion identifies the frontend application version for compatibility tracking.

duration_ms.description: DurationMs records how long the client spent on the assessment before requesting a plan.

session_id.description: SessionID is a client-generated correlation identifier.

timestamp_unix.description: TimestampUnix is the Unix epoch (seconds) at which the client created the request.

source.description: Source is the ID of the originating node (the dependent concept).

target.description: Target is the ID of the destination node (the prerequisite concept).

cognitive_state.description:
CognitiveState indicates the student's cognitive state for this concept.
Possible values:
  "failed"   -- the student explicitly failed this topic.
  "learning" -- this topic is a prerequisite of a failed topic.
  "mastered" -- no evidence of deficit; presumed mastered.
  "unassessed" -- no evidence when learner history is supplied.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for this node, equal to the knowledge-graph node name.

label.description: Label is the human-readable display text for the node.
